BiblicalUsage: Keviyah is a branding, a burn-mark left by fire. Exodus 21:25 sets it in the law of like for like: burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the brand matters because God measures out justice exactly, never more than the hurt and never less.
